findings.title: Settings POST silently resets shutdown_drain_timeout to 60.0 on every save
findings.problem: save_settings rebuilds new_config["general"] as a literal dict enumerating every general key by hand (log_level, hard_max_per_cycle, max_history_rows, request_timeout, page_size, tracking_window_minutes, tracking_delay_seconds, max_consecutive_failures, skip_unreleased). The new shutdown_drain_timeout field is not in that dict, so SettingsModel(**new_config) constructs it at the 60.0 default. _settings_to_dict then serializes settings.general.model_dump() — which now INCLUDES shutdown_drain_timeout=60.0 — and _atomic_toml_write persists it. Net effect once the field lands: an operator who hand-edits shutdown_drain_timeout = 300.0 in triggarr.toml loses it the next time anyone saves the Settings form, silently overwritten to 60.0 on disk. Note the existing carve-out on the line above: tracking_delay_seconds is explicitly carried forward from current_settings.general precisely because it has no form input — the new field needs the same treatment (or the Plan 75-02 form input). Right now the field is orphaned: added to the model with no reader and no writer.
findings.fix_hint: Either land Plan 75-02's safe_float form parse, or carry the value forward like tracking_delay_seconds: "shutdown_drain_timeout": current_settings.general.shutdown_drain_timeout.
findings.why_it_matters: Silent data loss of an operator-set config value on an unrelated UI action. The operator sees a drain of 60s while their TOML said 300s, and nothing logs the reset.

findings.title: Wire the configured timeout into the shutdown drain
findings.problem: Setting general.shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 is now accepted, but shutdown still uses _SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT, initialized at module import from the environment or a hardcoded 60.0. No runtime code reads the new field. An operator increasing the drain budget therefore still gets forced resource closure after 60 seconds while a search holds the lock; lowering it likewise has no effect.
findings.why_it_matters: An operator increasing the drain budget still gets forced resource closure after 60 seconds while a search holds the lock; lowering it likewise has no effect.
findings.fix_hint: Resolve the drain timeout at shutdown from the active GeneralConfig, applying the environment override with finite-value validation, and use that resolved value for timeout enforcement and logging. Add an integration test proving a nondefault config value controls the drain.
source_window: # Defense in depth: a TOML inf cannot unbound the drain. Config value is the default;
# TRIGGARR_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT env overrides at shutdown; form clamp (3600.0) is the UI ceiling.
